items.name: Dagnar's Journal-Clasp
items.lore: A brass clasp from a mapmaker's journal, engraved with a compass rose.

items.name: Battered-Chest Belt
items.lore: Leather and brass from a chest that crossed Muspelheim.

items.name: Forgemaster's Bracer
items.lore: Fire-dwarf work. It glows at the edges when you're angry.

items.name: Lodestone Ring
items.lore: A sliver of lodestone set in silver. It always points home.

items.name: Ragnvald's Lay-Harp Charm
items.lore: A tiny bronze harp. The song it stands for is either true or famous. Not both.

items.name: Ashbeard Ring
items.lore: A huscarl's ring, scorched black by giant-fire.

items.name: Fire-Giant Thane Belt
items.lore: Broad enough for two men. Cut down, it fits one very well.

items.name: Cinder-Silk Cloak
items.lore: A cloak that cannot burn. The fire giants weave it from something they will not name.
